item.title: A strategic review, three pillars, and twelve programme models
item.description: The Foundation completed a strategic review of its programme architecture, refreshed the three-pillar structure, wrote a model for every programme, and published Edition 2 of the Corporate Profile.

item.title: Durumi IDP camp: a needs assessment, and a classroom built from within the camp
item.description: A multi-sector needs assessment at Durumi camp in the FCT, and an agreement with camp coordinators on a classroom furniture project — built by a carpenter living in the camp.

item.title: Love on the Street: a birthday marked with service in Keffi
item.description: On 20 May the founder's birthday was marked with service rather than celebration — supporting women traders in Keffi and honouring security personnel.

item.title: SAF Leadership Development Summit: strategic leadership in a changing world
item.description: A youth leadership summit on ethical leadership and emotional intelligence, attended by representatives of the Emir of Keffi.

item.title: MindCheck launches: a free, confidential way to reach support early
item.description: On 21 January, with SpeakOut Mental Health Outreach, the Foundation piloted and launched the MindCheck App — a free, confidential platform to assess wellbeing and reach support early.

item.title: Students take wellbeing education into the streets of Keffi
item.description: On 19 January, with students of the College of Health Science and Technology, Keffi, volunteers took mental-health education across the community.

item.title: Pad A Girl reaches ECWA School, Keffi
item.description: On 22 May 2025, with Deborah Counselling Consult, Pad A Girl delivered health education, safeguarding sensitisation and the distribution of pads and books at ECWA School, Keffi.
